observation.command:
cd /workspace
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec curl -sL http://localhost/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "final: HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n"
grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/home.html | head -2
echo "=== enabled module count + key modules ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush pm --enabled -y --fields=enabled 2>/dev/null | grep -c "true" || true
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush php-eval '$mh=\Drupal::moduleHandler(); foreach(["openculturas","openculturas_map","openculturas_openstreetmap","geocoder","geocoder_geofield","leaflet","smart_date","address"] as $m) { echo $m . ": " . ($mh->moduleExists($m)?"ENABLED":"disabled") . "\n"; }' 2>&1 | head -12
